title: Line sketch: Whimsical Animal Pattern Mosaic
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A dense repeating pattern of stylized animals including birds, deer, cats and foxes scattered across a background.
